classification.difficultyReason: Read an intercept on an intermediate gridline, choose another point on the fitted line, calculate rise over run and express the result in linear equation form.

content.prompt:
A school is interested in the relationship between the number of days a fundraiser is promoted and the number of tickets sold.

The diagram shows the dataset used in the investigation and the least-squares regression line.

What is the equation of the least-squares regression line relating to the dataset?

spec.description: Five black circular markers and a dashed regression line; solid major grid and dotted intermediate horizontal grid, in the same style as p37-q13.
spec.mathematics: x from 0 to 10, ticks every 1; y from 0 to 36, labelled ticks every 4 and dotted intermediate lines every 2. Points (2,12), (4,14), (6,21), (8,28), (10,30). Dashed line y=2.5x+6, clipped at y=36. The line is the exact least-squares line of these points.
spec.answerVisibility: The dataset and dashed line are permanent givens. No equation label is printed.

answer.worked:
The line crosses the $y$-axis at 6. Two points on the line are $(0,6)$ and $(8,26)$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{26-6}{8-0}\\&=2.5\\y&=2.5x+6\end{aligned}$$
